hook: Their boat was sinking. The jetty was all they had.
narration: [tense, urgent] Their boat was taking on water, [short pause] and two people ended up stranded on the jetty rocks.
[calm documentary narrator] This is the South Jetty on Oregon's Coquille River. Waves surge between the rocks, so a boat can't get close.
[building energy] So a Dolphin crew from Air Station North Bend came from above and sent the swimmer and the basket straight down.
outcome: [relieved] The North Bend crew hoisted both people off the jetty rocks.
title: Stranded on jetty rocks as boat sank
description:
Two people were stranded on the rocks of the South Jetty in Oregon's Coquille River after their boat began taking on water on Aug. 3, 2026. An MH-65 Dolphin crew from Coast Guard Air Station North Bend hoisted them off the rocks.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station North Bend, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1017405
